Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates near-complete opacification (whiteout) of the right hemithorax with a contralateral mediastinal shift to the left, which is the classic radiographic presentation of a massive right pleural effusion causing mass effect. This aligns with the physical exam finding of dullness and distinguishes it from atelectasis (which would cause an ipsilateral shift) or pneumothorax (which would appear hyperlucent).
